messages.message:
Patch Set 2:

(17 comments)

AI code review results below, please doublecheck

Some concerns, see inline comments. The stated goal doesn't look reachable yet: on a 5.15 kernel with in-kernel fscrypt (HAVE_FSCRYPT_SET_CONTEXT set, CONFIG_LL_ENCRYPTION unset) the three remaining llcrypt_inherit_context() call sites still expand to fscrypt_inherit_context(), and lustre_compat/fs/crypto/keysetup.c loses all of its #include lines in that configuration. Separately, this changes when ll_set_encflags() runs for mkdir/mknod/create and moves ll_create_it() under ll_lookup_it_finish() - those are client-visible behaviour changes that would be worth a sanity-sec case rather than relying on the existing tests.

parents.subject: LU-18876 build: changes needed for dropping into kernel tree

commit.subject: LU-20108 sec: support fscrypt natively for Linux 5.15
commit.message:
LU-20108 sec: support fscrypt natively for Linux 5.15

Currently Lustre only supports up to 5.8 kernels. This work
handles the replacement of fscrypt_inherit_context() with
fscrypt_prepare_new_inode() and fscrypt_set_context(). So the
encrypt context is done in a two step process.

Test-Parameters: trivial testlist=sanity-sec
Change-Id: Ie8defa6e71fecddfd773e01f93d7ae3cb8d6e18e
Signed-off-by: James Simmons <jsimmons@infradead.org>
